get.description: Returns the latest known tank levels of a Hydraloop device: tank2 (leveled) and tank3, plus tank2b for H600 devices (the B-side of the T2 pair). Each tank reports a percentage (integer 0-100, same window definition as the device dashboard: T2/T2B over the calibrated pressure window 80→590 hPa (V1_5) / 80→596 hPa (V2_0); T3 from its minimum (87 hPa) up to the dashboard-full level) and the calibrated liters (one decimal). Tanks without data are returned as `null`. For H600 devices `tank2b` is a separate entry with its own percentage and liters; it is `null` for all other device types and for H600 devices without B-side data. Non-Hydraloop devices are rejected with 400 (tank levels do not apply to that device type).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Id of the device. Must be a device assigned to the API key.

400.description: deviceId is missing or not valid, or the device is not a Hydraloop device (tank levels do not apply to that device type).

401.description: API key missing or invalid, or the deviceId is not assigned to the API key.

get.summary: Latest tank levels

get.description: Returns the tank level history of a Hydraloop device for a calendar month: one point per hour (average of the readings within the hour; hours without data are omitted) for tank2, tank3 and tank2b (H600 only). `x` is the hour bucket start as UTC ISO-8601, in the same style as the recycled-water endpoints. The percentage and liters use the same definition as `tank-levels`, applied to the hourly average pressure. Notes: tank2 is leveled only when the T1/T2 tanks are leveled (typically 1-2 samples per day, so the series is sparse by design); the tank3 series is served from a continuously refreshed one-hour aggregate that lags by about a day, so the most recent hours of the current month may be missing or incomplete; in half-hour timezones the tank2/tank2b hour labels are shifted 30 minutes relative to the tank3 labels. Non-Hydraloop devices are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Id of the device. Must be a device assigned to the API key.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Timezone to use, defaults to UTC. Use INANA timezone notation like "Europe/Amsterdam" or a fixed offset like "+01:00" or "UTC+1".

400.description: deviceId is missing or not valid, the device is not a Hydraloop device, or year/month is out of range.

401.description: API key missing or invalid, or the deviceId is not assigned to the API key.
